title: Nice, but pricey and a bit too large for my needs.
text: Nice, but pricey and a bit too large for my needs.. So i bought 2 of these based on recommendations as I was having a dble mastectomy. They are cute and comfy but almost too puffy for my personal comfort. For the price, I woudl have skipped it. $60 wasnt worth it to me. Flatter fleece pillows made for me by a church were more effective for my situation.
